about:
# STOP DYING THERE!!!

This mod will play lines from Cold's iconic [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kNDpLgaQQqk) whenever you die in GD. 
The line chosen to play will scale in intensity depending on how far you are in the level (so early deaths have "calmer"
reactions, new bests have all of the, well, least calm reactions)

Specifics and toggles can be found in the mod settings. Have fun with this lol
changelog:
# 1.2.2
- Fixed a bug where sound effects play when any player dies in a Globed room

# 1.2.1
- v2.2081 support

# 1.2.0
- Added more customization options ("decent" versus "far" attempts)
- Spike-related SFX now only play if the player actually died to a spike

# 1.1.0
- Added an option to disable or censor profane sound effects (on by default)
- Added an option to disable the mod in Platformer levels
- Added more thorough customization options 
- Made some miscellaneous formatting/consistency fixes

# 1.0.1
- Geode compatibility fixes
- Fixed "Disable in practice mode" not disabling the endscreen sound

# 1.0.0
- Basic mod functionality
